protocols.title: Debt/credit burdens and subsequent systemic banking crises
protocols.definition: Higher private-credit burden and weaker external positions are associated with higher later systemic-banking-crisis onset risk.
protocols.scientific_rationale: Long debt-cycle mechanisms predict repayment stress before financial-system breakdown.
protocols.target_outcome: source-defined systemic banking crisis onset (initially JST crisisJST=1)

research_population.selection_rule: predefined JST R6 source coverage; outcomes were not used to select countries

predictor_variables.transformation: lagged level and five-year change; source units preserved

information_cutoff_rules.leakage_guard: predictor period < outcome year; dataset-version fixed to JST R6

forecast_horizons.event: onset only; ongoing-crisis state is separate

protocols.falsification_criteria: No out-of-sample discrimination above base rate or an exploratory-only result is evidence inconsistent with predictive value.
known_limitations: IMF 2026 dataset unavailable at implementation time

protocols.title: Private-credit expansion and subsequent systemic banking crises
protocols.definition: Private non-financial credit expansion (distinct from public debt) is associated with higher later systemic-banking-crisis onset risk.
protocols.scientific_rationale: Long debt-cycle mechanisms emphasise private-sector leverage accumulation; the registered H01-P1.0 public-debt protocol cannot stand in as a test of private credit.
protocols.target_outcome: source-defined systemic banking crisis onset (JST crisisJST=1), same registry as H01-P1.0

research_population.selection_rule: predefined JST R6 source coverage; identical panel as H01-P1.0 for comparability

predictor_variables.transformation: lagged level and changes measured strictly before outcome year; source units preserved

information_cutoff_rules.leakage_guard: predictor period < outcome year; dataset-version fixed to JST R6
information_cutoff_rules.holdout_integrity_disclosure: The 1990-2020 holdout was already used for exploratory private-credit predictor inspection during the H01-P1.0 forensic audit; it is NOT an untouched confirmatory holdout for predictor selection. All results are retrospective diagnostics.

measurement_method.benchmark: unconditional country-year base rate + public-debt control
measurement_method.cluster_handling: crisis episodes grouped from globally co-moving onset years (max gap 3y); leave-one-episode-out, leave-one-country-out, decade time-blocks, ex-2007-2008 sensitivity, year-block bootstrap intervals

protocols.falsification_criteria: No out-of-sample discrimination above the public-debt control or base rate is evidence inconsistent with private-credit predictive value; positive retrospective discrimination remains exploratory, not confirmatory.
known_limitations: annual onset only; 13 of 19 held-out events in 2007-2008 and 4 in 1991 form just 3 independent episodes
predictor family partially pre-screened on the same holdout; no untouched confirmatory sample remains in JST R6
debt-service and credit-gap measures are derived proxies, not official BIS DSR/gap series

protocols.title: Debt/GDP level thresholds and crisis heterogeneity
protocols.definition: Dedicated research into whether debt-to-GDP LEVEL thresholds (public or private) carry reproducible crisis information — across countries, eras, monetary regimes and debt type — instead of the H01-P1.0 change-based test.
protocols.scientific_rationale: Q14 asks for a reproducible threshold; the change-based H01-P1.0 protocol never tested levels and could not answer it.
protocols.target_outcome: source-defined systemic banking crisis onset (JST crisisJST=1)

predictor_variables.transformation: lagged level at origin; pooled train p80 vs per-country p80 thresholds; regime and era splits

information_cutoff_rules.leakage_guard: thresholds estimated on pre-1990 train only; no threshold fitted to maximise test performance

measurement_method.model: pooled vs within-country train-percentile level thresholds; pegged/non-pegged regime split; gold/interwar/Bretton-Woods/fiat era split

protocols.falsification_criteria: If no level threshold reproduces above-chance discrimination out of sample and per-country thresholds are not portable, the universal-threshold claim is unsupported; conditional heterogeneity then defines the open research question rather than a falsified result.
known_limitations: threshold concepts differ across debt types and eras
financial development trends make level thresholds non-stationary

protocols.title: Institutional deterioration and later investment/productivity weakness
protocols.definition: WGI deterioration and inequality/institutional proxies are candidates for predicting later investment or productivity weakness.
protocols.scientific_rationale: Internal-order theory links institutional cohesion to productive capacity.
protocols.target_outcome: independently defined persistent productivity/investment weakness (outcome registry not yet populated)
protocols.falsification_criteria: Unavailable outcome evidence means untestable, not supported.

protocols.title: Relative international-power convergence and rivalry/crisis risk
protocols.definition: Power convergence between major states may precede independently dated rivalry, conflict or order-transition episodes.
protocols.target_outcome: independent rivalry, conflict or order-transition outcome registry (not populated)
protocols.falsification_criteria: No independent outcome evidence means untestable.

protocols.title: Recurring long sequences of monetary, domestic and external order changes
protocols.definition: Historical orders may recur through a long sequence spanning decades to centuries.
protocols.scientific_rationale: The broad Big Cycle claim motivates separated long-run measurements.
protocols.target_outcome: independently dated complete order-transition cycles (not populated)
protocols.falsification_criteria: Current evidence cannot test a universal duration or deterministic sequence.
known_limitations: no consistent multi-century entities or outcomes
